output.text: Is there a tsunami warning or not? The police at the East Beach told us there is no warning, but people are running up the hill. My children are still on the sand.
I'm at the port. The ferry passengers are coming off slowly. There are hundreds of people trying to call their families and the network does not work at all here.
Hi, love. The lights are out everywhere, but we're fine. I'm going over to Aunt Selma's with the kids. Don't come into town. The roads are a mess.
There is a woman in labor in our building on Harbor Road. The contractions are three minutes apart and the hospital line does not answer. What do we do?
Hello, I'm calling about the restaurant. The freezers will spoil without power. Who do I call about renting a generator?
My father's dialysis is due today and the clinic is closed. He is dizzy and his ankles are swollen. Where can we take him?
Just checking you got home okay. We're fine here, the house is fine. Call me back when you can.
Coast Guard Unit 1 to control. We can talk on Tetra but we cannot receive the port's passenger manifest. We need a data connection at the port. Over.
